domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split could be retrieved. Search engines (DuckDuckGo/searx) were unreachable (connection refused) and Google/Bing returned no relevant results; zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403. Therefore no domestic supply record was seen — this is a data-access gap, not a finding of absence.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records: three outbound consignments of COROCAM UV corona-detection cameras (HS 90275090) from Bangalore air cargo to Russia (Sheremetyevo/Moscow) between 2025-01-09 and 2025-10-15, with B/L numbers 7146118, 3405598 and 2446463. The company is therefore an exporter/re-exporter of UV imaging cameras sourced from UVIRCO Technologies (South Africa) — i.e. it acts as a distributor/trader rather than a manufacturer, though the role field is outside this task. Declared HS 902750 matches the actual customs HS 90275090, so no HS correction is needed. Domestic (India) supply activity could not be verified from public sources within the tool budget; GST turnover and GeM/CPPP participation remain null and unverified. No rejection grounds: the entity appears active in customs data as recently as 2025-10-15.
